strategy_roster.name: SPY TLT
strategy_roster.notes: The engine evaluates a single series, so the documented TLT trend signal is proxied by the same instrument's close versus the documented SMA Length 20, keeping the cross-above/close-below structure intact. Cross-asset timing and the 2014-2099 window are not expressible, and the docs state there are no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Brandy v1.2 Strategy (C#)
strategy_roster.notes: The documented LongPeriod 70 and ShortPeriod 20 SMAs are kept, and the backward shifts of 5 bars are approximated by comparing each against a longer SMA (80 and 30) since the DSL cannot index a past bar. Exit is the documented slope reversal, and StopLossPoints 50 / TrailingStopPoints 150 are price steps, not percentages.

strategy_roster.name: ColorJFatl Digit TM Plus
strategy_roster.notes: The FATL digital filter smoothed by a Jurik MA is approximated by a fast/slow EMA pair, and the documented colour change on the latest finished bar becomes a cross in the new slope direction. JmaLength has no documented default so 5/20 are explicit fallbacks; the timed exit, SignalBar offset and price-step stop/target are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Supertrend AT v1.0
strategy_roster.notes: The SuperTrend line is approximated by EMA(10) with the documented SupertrendLength 10 and Multiplier 3 on ATR(10); the entry is the documented down-to-up flip above the band and the exit is the loss of the bullish regime. RiskPerTrade 2% and RewardRatio 3 size the position and its target from the previous Supertrend value, which the DSL cannot express, so the stop fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Ultimate T3 Fibonacci BTC Scalping
strategy_roster.notes: Tilson T3 is approximated by triple EMA smoothing, keeping the documented fast-above-slow crossover and the opposite-cross exit. The 0.618 volume factor behind the Fibonacci-tuned T3 line is not reproducible, so periods 5/20 are explicit fallbacks, and the optional percentage TP/SL has no documented values so both stop fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Cumulative Delta Breakout
strategy_roster.entry_long: sma((close - open) * volume,20) > donchian_high_prev(sma((close - open) * volume,20),20)
strategy_roster.notes: Cumulative delta is not available in OHLCV, so it is proxied by the LookbackPeriod 20 average of signed close-open volume, and the documented breakout is a new 20-bar extreme of that series (prior-bar window so the current bar is not self-referential). The exit is the documented cross back through zero, and the stop is referenced but never quantified, so the stop fields are null.

strategy_roster.name: Fibonacci Swing Trading Bot
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 0.786 and 0.618 retracements of the last 50-bar range are rebuilt from Donchian levels, with the long entry on the break above the deeper level and the exit on a fall back through the shallow one. The documented StopLossPercent 1 is applied; RiskRewardRatio 2 is a multiple of the stop rather than a percentage, so take_profit_pct stays null.

strategy_roster.name: Neon Momentum Waves
strategy_roster.notes: The documented FastLength 12, SlowLength 26 and SignalLength 20 are used, and the histogram (MACD line minus signal) crossing the EntryLevel 0 gives the long entry. The exit uses the documented LongExitLevel 11, which daily histograms rarely reach, so positions are held long; the docs state there are no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Close on Profit or Loss in Account Currency
strategy_roster.notes: Non-trading: the documented module only watches portfolio equity and liquidates positions when the account-currency Positive/Negative Closure thresholds are hit; it never opens trades, and account equity is not an OHLCV series. Marked with a never-true guard.

strategy_roster.name: RSI CCI Williams %R
strategy_roster.entry_long: rsi(close,14) < 30 and (close - sma(close,20)) / (0.015 * std(close,20)) < -100 and 100 * (close - donchian_high(high,14)) / (donchian_high(high,14) - donchian_low(low,14)) < -80
strategy_roster.notes: CCI is rebuilt from its standard formula and Williams %R from the 14-bar range position, and the long entry requires all three oscillators oversold at once; RSI 30 / CCI -100 / %R -80 are explicit fallbacks because no thresholds are documented. Since exits are only percentage TP/SL with no values, the mirrored RSI overbought condition is used as the signal exit and the stop fields are null.
